import sys, os, glob
sys.path.insert(0, "/tmp/.local/lib/python3.12/site-packages")
for libdir in glob.glob("/tmp/.local/lib/python3.12/site-packages/*.libs"):
    os.environ["LD_LIBRARY_PATH"] = libdir + ":" + os.environ.get("LD_LIBRARY_PATH", "")

import geopandas as gpd
import pandas as pd
from pyproj import Geod, CRS

park_gdf = gpd.GeoDataFrame.from_features(park_geojson["features"], crs="EPSG:4326")
district_gdf = gpd.GeoDataFrame.from_features(district_geojson["features"], crs="EPSG:4326")

geod = Geod(ellps="WGS84")
truth = {
    "park": abs(geod.geometry_area_perimeter(park_gdf.geometry.iloc[0])[0]) / 1e6,
    "dist": abs(geod.geometry_area_perimeter(district_gdf.geometry.iloc[0])[0]) / 1e6,
}

# A locally-optimized Albers Equal Area centered on the data (lon_0 from centroid, std parallels ±1.5°)
cx, cy = -73.965, 40.765
local_albers = CRS.from_proj4(
    f"+proj=aea +lat_1={cy-1.5} +lat_2={cy+1.5} +lat_0={cy} +lon_0={cx} "
    f"+datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs"
)

candidates = {
    "EPSG:32618 UTM 18N (conformal)": CRS.from_epsg(32618),
    "EPSG:2263 NY Long Island (conformal, ftUS)": CRS.from_epsg(2263),
    "EPSG:5070 Conus Albers (equal-area)": CRS.from_epsg(5070),
    "EPSG:6933 EASE 2.0 Global (equal-area)": CRS.from_epsg(6933),
    "Custom local Albers (equal-area)": local_albers,
}

rows = []
for label, crs in candidates.items():
    # NOTE: pass CRS object so geopandas can read the unit for correct interpretation
    pm = park_gdf.set_crs(4326).to_crs(crs)
    dm = district_gdf.set_crs(4326).to_crs(crs)
    # unit factor: 1 unit -> metres squared
    try:
        to_m = crs.axis_info[0].unit_conversion_factor  # metres per CRS unit
    except Exception:
        to_m = 1.0
    p = pm.geometry.area.iloc[0] * to_m**2 / 1e6
    d = dm.geometry.area.iloc[0] * to_m**2 / 1e6
    rows.append({
        "crs": label,
        "unit": crs.axis_info[0].unit_name,
        "park_km2": p, "dist_km2": d,
        "park_err_%": (p - truth["park"]) / truth["park"] * 100,
        "dist_err_%": (d - truth["dist"]) / truth["dist"] * 100,
    })

res = pd.DataFrame(rows)
pd.set_option("display.float_format", lambda v: f"{v:,.5f}")
print(f"Ground truth geodesic  |  Park: {truth['park']:.5f} km^2 | District: {truth['dist']:.5f} km^2\n")
print(res.to_string(index=False))
